a11y.search_a_s_rah_name_or_number: Search a sūrah — name or number
about.audio_keeps_playing_while_you: Audio keeps playing while you use the rest of the app or other apps. If the stream doesn’t start, the masjid may not be broadcasting at the moment.
about.in_february_1988_to_accommodate: In February 1988, to accommodate the growing community, the present building on Blackburn Road was purchased — formerly a Congregational Sunday School. The first Imam in the new masjid was Qari Yakub Nanjee Saheb, followed by Qari Farook Saheb.
about.one_of_the_first_masjids: One of the first masjids in Bolton.
about.plans_are_in_the_works: Plans are in the works to give the community a safe and welcoming space for learning, socialising and conducting ceremonies — and an educational resource for young and old alike.
about.the_masjid_also_intends_to: The masjid also intends to invest further in Islamic education, supporting the community in matters including marriage and burial practices, and to establish an Islamic educational and cultural centre and library.
about.the_masjid_was_originally_located: The masjid was originally located in Canning Street, where Moulana Faruq Desai was appointed as its first Imam.
about.the_name_taiyabah_from_the: The name *Taiyabah* — from the Arabic _Tayyab_, meaning purity — was given by the late Hazrat Sheikh Moulana Mohammed Zakariyya Saheb, author of _Fazaail-e-Amaal_.
adm.a_birth_certificate_valid_passport: A birth certificate, valid passport or ID card is needed once a place has been confirmed.
adm.a_haircut_acceptable_in_islam: A haircut acceptable in Islam. Mohicans, mullets and unblended number 0 or 1 back and sides are not permitted — the hair must be equal.
adm.abaya_and_burkhi: Abaya and burkhi, long enough to cover the chest and hair.
adm.absence_not_reported_on_the_day: Absence not reported on the day is recorded as unauthorised
adm.attendance_is_taken_seriously: Attendance is taken seriously, because a class only works if the children in it are there. The madrasah expects at least 90% attendance across the year, and a child consistently below that by the end of a term will lose their place.
adm.children_arriving_without_the_correc: Children arriving without the correct uniform, or with an unacceptable hairstyle, are sent home.
adm.compulsory_for_children_up_to: Compulsory for children up to Year 6 (ages 3–11) from November to March, while it is dark during madrasah hours.
adm.fees_class_times_and_what: Fees, class times and what the madrasah asks of students and parents — everything worth knowing before you apply.
adm.if_you_must_travel_during: If you must travel during term, collect a Holiday Absence Form from the madrasah office and return it three weeks before you travel. Without it, the absence is unauthorised. A handwritten letter is not accepted in place of the form.
adm.lateness_counts_towards_the_attendan: Lateness counts towards the attendance figure
adm.please_make_sure_your_child: Please make sure your child has been before leaving home. If there is an accident during madrasah, you will be called to collect them.
adm.raise_anything_with_the_office: Raise anything with the office manager rather than the teacher. It will be handled confidentially.
adm.ring_the_office_on_the_day: Ring the office on the day, between 5pm and 7pm
adm.students_and_parents_are_expected: Students and parents are expected to follow all current madrasah policies. Copies are available from the office on request.
adm.submitting_an_application_does_not: Submitting an application does not mean your child has been granted a place. Classes fill quickly, and where a class is already full, applicants are added to a waiting list and contacted when a space comes up. Admission to Hifz is additionally subject to the headteacher’s approval.
adm.tell_us_if_your_child_will_be_late: Tell us if your child will be late, not only if absent
adm.the_admission_fee_is_payable: The admission fee is payable once your child has been granted a place. Fees are collected through the madrasah office or the parent portal, and are payable whether or not your child attends. Fees are reviewed each year — please confirm the current rate with the office when you apply.
adm.the_form_asks_for_your_child: The form asks for your child's details and the class you are applying for, and shows which classes are open and when applications close.
adm.the_madrasah_follows_the_school: The madrasah follows the school term dates recommended by Bolton Council, so holidays should be arranged outside term time wherever possible.
adm.the_madrasah_has_taught_the: The madrasah has taught the community’s children since 1967, from age 4 through to Hifz and the Alimiyyah course. Everything below applies to every student, and submitting an application means agreeing to it.
adm.the_office_takes_admission_queries: The office takes admission queries between 5pm and 7pm.
adm.you_will_need_a_working: You will need a working email address: it is how the office reaches you, and how you will sign in to the parent portal once your child has a place.
advice.answer_by_email: The answer comes back to the email address you gave. Questions are answered in the order they arrive, and some take a few days.
advice.appointments_are_arranged_through: Appointments are arranged through the office, so the imam can make time to see you properly rather than in passing.
advice.call_the_main_office_to: Call the main office to book
advice.check_the_form: Please fill in every box, and check the email address — that is where the answer goes.
advice.couldnt_send: That didn't send. Please try again, or ask at the masjid office.
advice.every_box_is_needed_so: Every box is needed: the imam has to know who he is answering, where to send his answer, and how to reach you if ringing would be kinder than writing.
advice.if_this_is_urgent_please_ring: If this is urgent, or you would rather speak to somebody, please ring the number above instead of writing.
advice.if_you_would_like_to: If you would like to arrange a time to speak with one of the imams, please contact the main office to make an appointment.
advice.many_in_the_community_turn: Many in the community turn to the masjid for guidance on matters affecting their day-to-day lives. Our imams are able to advise on a range of subjects, including marriage, bereavement, family matters, and general Islamic guidance.
advice.not_taking_written: The masjid is not taking written questions at the moment.
advice.please_ring_the_office_and_an_ima: Please ring the office on the number above and somebody will arrange a time for you to speak to an imam.
advice.question_sent: Your question is with the imams
advice.subject: What is it about?
advice.thats_where_the_answer_goes: That is where the answer goes.
advice.the_imams_answer_is_sent_here: The imam’s answer is sent to this address, so please check it.
advice.what_it_is_about: What it is about — one short line
advice.what_you_write_here_is_read: What you write here is read by *the imams and by nobody else at the masjid* — not the office, not the committee, not an administrator. The imam answers you by email.
advice.written_questions_are_not_being: Written questions are not being taken just now
advice.you_will_get_no_email_confirming: You will not get an email confirming this was sent — your reference is shown on this screen instead, so nothing about it lands in an inbox somebody else may read.
alerts.armed: reminders set for the week ahead. They are refreshed each time you open the app.
alerts.denied: Notifications are turned off for this app in the phone's settings, so nothing can be scheduled. Turn them on there and come back.
alerts.notices_note: Announcements from the office — janāzah notices, madrasah closures, Ramadan timings — appear on the Notices tab. Push notifications for those are being set up and will arrive in a later version of the app.
alerts.sub: Be reminded before jamāʿah, with no signal needed.
app.the_best_day_on_which: “The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday.”

athkar.confirm_the_wording_with_the: Confirm the wording with the imam

birth.a_service_of_bcom: A service of Bolton Council of Mosques, independent of Taiyabah Masjid.
birth.bcom_does_not_circumcise_babies: BCoM does not circumcise babies over 18 months old.
birth.circumcision_can_be_arranged_throu: Circumcision can be arranged through the *Bolton Council of Mosques (BCoM)*, which runs a long-established weekly clinic performed by experienced NHS doctors.
birth.congratulations_on_the_arrival_of: Congratulations on the arrival of your child. This section brings together guidance and services relevant to a newborn.
bukhari.needs_connection: The narrations are fetched from the masjid's site as you open each book, so this one needs a connection. The book list works without one.
bukhari.no_translation_note: The Arabic is 9th-century and free to reproduce. Every complete English translation in circulation is a modern work still in copyright, so rather than copy one, each hadith links out to its English on sunnah.com. That needs a connection; the Arabic does not.
bukhari.title: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī
collect.a_clear_photo_is_fine: A clear photo is fine. JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, up to 5 MB.
collect.announcements_are_only_allowed_a: Announcements are only allowed *after Asr and after Isha*, and must last *no more than two minutes*.
collect.certificate_needed: The application needs your BMCC certificate attached, so it opens on the masjid's website. Everything you have read here applies to it.
collect.charities_and_institutes_are_wel: Charities and institutes are welcome to collect here. Fill this in and the masjid office will contact your trustee to confirm a date. Nothing on this screen books a day — it is a request, and the masjid will be in touch.
collect.collect_for_your_cause: Collect for your cause at Taiyabah Masjid
collect.collection_starts_after_zohr: Collection starts *after Zohr salah* and ends *after Isha salah*.
collect.date_you_would_like_to: Date you would like to collect
collect.days_notice_and_takes_requests: days’ notice, and takes requests up to a year ahead.
collect.do_they_receive_any_wage: Do they receive any wage or commission for this collection?
collect.every_question_is_needed_unless: Every question is needed unless it says otherwise. The masjid rings the trustee named at the bottom before confirming anything, so please give a number that will be answered.
collect.full_name_of_trustee_ceo: Full name of trustee / CEO / principal
collect.i_have_read_the_rules: I have read the *rules for collection* above and agree to them on behalf of the charity or institute named on this form.
collect.i_understand_the_masjid_will: I understand the masjid will keep these details to arrange and check the collection, will contact the trustee named above, and will delete them afterwards in line with its privacy notice. I confirm the trustee is content to be contacted about this.
collect.if_your_madrasah_or_school: If your madrasah or school has students, it helps the masjid to know how many, and how many of them board. Leave both empty if it does not apply.
collect.leave_this_empty_if_the: Leave this empty if the cause is overseas or not registered in England and Wales.
collect.name_of_the_person_doing: Name of the person doing the collection
collect.only_one_collection_is_allowed: Only one collection is allowed on any given day, so an early request has the best chance of the date you want.
collect.photo_or_scan_of_the: Photo or scan of the certificate
collect.requests_by_phone_for_now: Requests are taken by phone for now
collect.somebody_other_than_the_collecto: Somebody other than the collector. The masjid rings this person to confirm the collection is genuine.
collect.thank_you_for_saying_so: Thank you for saying so. A paid collector is allowed — the masjid simply needs to know beforehand, and the committee may ask about it when they ring.
collect.the_masjid_cannot_take_a: The masjid *cannot take a request without this*. Bolton Masjid Chanda Committee issues the certificate, and it must have been issued *within the last three months*.
collect.the_masjid_rings_the_trustee: The masjid rings the trustee or manager you name — somebody other than the collector — to check the collection is genuine before confirming.
collect.the_masjid_will_contact_your: The masjid will contact your trustee to confirm. Nothing here reserves a date.
collect.this_form_is_not_open: This form is not open yet. Please ring the number below and the masjid will take the details.
collect.typing_your_name_here_has: Typing your name here has the same effect as signing the paper form. The date and time are recorded with it.
collect.you_are_agreeing_to_this: · you are agreeing to this version

cur.class_times_fees_and_how: Class times, fees and how to apply are under Admissions & Fees.
cur.what_students_learn_at_the: What students learn at the madrasah.
duas.confirm_the_wording_with_the: Confirm the wording with the imam
duas.du_as_for_the_day: Duʿās for the day, with transliteration
duas.wording_varies_between_narrations_a: Wording varies between narrations and printings.
edu.a_one_off_session_run: A one-off session, run periodically rather than to a fixed timetable. Register and the office will tell you when the next one is.
edu.adults_aged_16_and_over_mens: Adults aged 16 and over. Men’s and women’s classes are taught separately.
edu.adults_aged_16_and_over_sessions: Adults aged 16 and over. Men’s and women’s sessions are run separately, because men wash men and women wash women.
edu.classes_and_workshops_at_the: Classes and workshops at the masjid for adults, alongside the children’s madrasah.
edu.complete_beginners_are_welcome: Complete beginners are welcome. Say roughly where you are when you register and you will be placed accordingly.
edu.evening_arabic_for_adults: Evening Arabic for adults, taught at the masjid — from the alphabet upward.
edu.every_course_below_is_open: Every course below is open to adults aged 16 and over, taught at the masjid, with men’s and women’s sessions run separately. Places are limited and registration is required — you cannot simply turn up.
edu.fifteen_per_class_small_on: Fifteen per class. Small on purpose — a language class stops working much beyond that.
edu.fifteen_per_session_after_that: Fifteen per session. After that, names go on the list for the session after.
edu.how_to_wash_and_prepare: How to wash and prepare a body for burial — a duty that falls on the community, and one most people have never been shown.
edu.if_you_have_had_a: If you have had a bereavement and need help now, this is not the screen you want — the masjid’s funeral service is available around the clock. Ring the office, or open Birth, Marriage & Death from the menu.
edu.in_practice_most_families_discover: In practice most families discover, in the worst week of their lives, that they do not know how and do not know who to ask. This workshop exists so that fewer families are in that position — and so that when it happens on your street, someone nearby can step in.
edu.it_is_taught_at_the: It is taught at the masjid, which has its own mortuary, so what you are shown is what you would actually be doing in the room.
edu.none_expected_most_people_who: None expected. Most people who come have never done it. Those who have are welcome too — the masjid needs more of you.
edu.places_are_limited_to_fifteen: Places are limited to fifteen per class and go in the order people sign up. Ring the office to put your name down in the meantime.
edu.required_you_cannot_simply_turn: Required — you cannot simply turn up. Places go in the order they are taken; after fifteen, the rest join a waiting list.
edu.sessions_are_announced_when_they: Sessions are announced when they are scheduled. Ring the office to be told about the next one.
edu.shrouding_the_kafan_and_how: Shrouding — the kafan, and how it is prepared
edu.tajweed_seerah_a_womens_circle: Tajweed, Seerah, a women’s circle — tell the office what you’d like taught
edu.the_adab_of_it_modesty: The adab of it: modesty, gentleness, and holding your tongue afterwards
edu.the_aim_is_to_get: The aim is to get you reading and understanding the language of the Qur’an, not only reciting it. Classes start from the alphabet, so no previous study is assumed — and they run after the madrasah finishes, when the building is already open.
edu.the_office_takes_calls_between: The office takes calls between 5pm and 7pm.
edu.the_office_takes_calls_between_2: The office takes calls between 5pm and 7pm.
edu.the_washing_itself_taken_through: The washing itself, taken through step by step
edu.washing_the_body_of_someone: Washing the body of someone who has died is a farḍ kifāyah — an obligation on the community as a whole rather than on any one person. As long as enough people can do it, the duty is discharged for everyone. Where nobody can, it falls on everyone.
edu.what_follows_janazah_prayer_and: What follows — janāzah prayer, and the burial
edu.what_happens_in_the_hours: What happens in the hours after a death, and who to ring first
edu.what_is_needed_and_where: What is needed, and where the masjid keeps it
funeral.a_death_has_to_be: A death has to be registered, and the hospital or coroner has to release the deceased, before a burial can go ahead. Bolton Council of Mosques handles that side — liaising with the council and the hospital — which is why they are the first call. The masjid then takes care of the ghusl, the kafn, the janāzah and the burial itself.
funeral.bolton_council_of_mosques_runs: Bolton Council of Mosques runs the borough’s Muslim funeral service and will liaise with the council and the hospital on your behalf. They answer out of hours. Once they are involved, the masjid will arrange everything set out below.
funeral.catering_for_mourners_can_be: Catering for mourners can be arranged at Astley Hall. Masjid seating can also be provided.
funeral.everything_here_is_arranged_by: Everything here is arranged by the masjid. If you are unsure what is needed or in what order, ring the office and someone will talk you through it.
funeral.if_someone_has_just_passed: If someone has just passed away
funeral.please_check_with_the_office: Please check with the office before making arrangements. What can be provided depends on the circumstances and on when the deceased is released. Nothing here should be taken as confirmed for a particular funeral until the masjid has spoken to you.
funeral.refrigerated_preservation_at_the: Refrigerated preservation at the masjid where there is a wait before the burial can take place.
funeral.taiyabah_masjid_supports_familie: Taiyabah Masjid supports families through every part of an Islamic funeral, from the first phone call to the burial.
funeral.the_deceased_is_transported_betw: The deceased is transported between the hospital, the masjid and the cemetery.
funeral.the_funeral_prayer_is_held: The funeral prayer is held at the masjid. The office will confirm the time so that family and community can attend.
funeral.the_imams_are_available_to: The imams are available to the family afterwards, for guidance and for the questions that come later.
funeral.the_masjid_arranges_the_burial: The masjid arranges the burial itself and co-ordinates with the cemetery so the family does not have to.
funeral.the_ritual_washing_of_the: The ritual washing of the deceased, carried out at the masjid according to Islamic practice.
funeral.the_shroud_is_provided_and: The shroud is provided and the deceased is prepared in the proper manner.
funeral.wasiyyah_why_and_how: Wasiyyah — why and how to prepare one
funeral.you_do_not_need_to: You do not need to work out who does what. Ring either number and you will be pointed the right way.
giving.a_building_used_this_heavily: A building used this heavily needs work done on it, and most of it is not the sort anybody notices until it fails.
giving.a_weekly_gift_for_jumuah: A weekly gift for Jumuʿah. Stripe takes it every seven days from the day you start, so set it up on a Friday if you would like it to land on one. You can stop it any time.
giving.choose_another_amount: Choose another amount, or use the bank details below
giving.every_prayer_held_here: Every prayer held here, every child taught, every janāzah carried out rests on what the community gives. This page is for the masjid itself — its upkeep, its running, and the work it does in Bolton.
giving.gift_aid_if_you_are: *Gift Aid:* if you are a UK taxpayer, tick *Yes* on the payment page and the masjid reclaims *25p for every £1* at no cost to you. You will need to give your name and home address there.
giving.given_purely_for_the_sake: Given purely for the sake of Allah, with nothing expected in return.
giving.heating_lighting_water_and_insura: Heating, lighting, water and insurance. The masjid is open for five prayers a day, every day of the year, and that is the bill behind it.
giving.opens_the_masjid_s_secure: Opens the masjid’s secure donation page. Card payments carry a small processing fee — a bank transfer below reaches the masjid in full, if that suits you better.
giving.please_use_your_surname_as: Please use your surname as the reference. If you are a UK taxpayer and want the masjid to claim Gift Aid on a transfer, ring the office — a declaration has to be held for it.
giving.serving_people_in_bolton_who: Serving people in Bolton who need it, Muslim and non-Muslim alike.
giving.taken_once_a_month_from: Taken once a month from the day you set it up, until you stop it. You can cancel any time from the receipt Stripe emails you.
giving.teaching_the_children_of_the: Teaching the children of the community, as it has since 1967. Fees do not cover it.
giving.the_general_fund_upkeep_running: The general fund — upkeep, running costs, and the masjid’s work in Bolton.
giving.the_mortuary_the_ghusl_facilities: The mortuary, the ghusl facilities and the help given to families at the hardest time. The masjid does not charge for this.
giving.voluntary_charity_given_as_and: Voluntary charity, given as and when you wish.
giving.zakat_is_not_taken_here: *Zakāt is not taken here.* It has its own categories — please ring the office on 01204 535 997.
hallhire.available_for_hire_for_communit: Available for hire, for community and family events.
hallhire.balance_due_30_days: The *balance* is due 30 days before your booking date and is paid at the office: cash, or bank transfer to *Bolton Central Islamic Society*.
hallhire.bookings_up_to_12_months: Bookings can be made up to 12 months ahead.
hallhire.caretaker_will_call: The caretaker will call you before the day to arrange access.
hallhire.check_the_form: Please choose what you need, a date, and fill in every box.
hallhire.couldnt_send: That didn't send. Please try again, or ring the office on 01204 535 997.
hallhire.date_held: The date is held for you
hallhire.deposit_books_the_date: *Paying the £100 deposit books the date.* Choose your day, fill in the short form and pay — the date is yours as soon as the deposit goes through, with nobody to wait for. It is held for you for thirty minutes while you pay.
hallhire.deposit_paid_online: *£100 deposit, paid online when you book.* That is what reserves the date — nothing else holds it. It is not refundable if you cancel, but it is refunded in full if the masjid cannot give you the date.
hallhire.gone: Somebody took that date while this form was open. Please choose another — the calendar has been refreshed.
hallhire.hire_is_whole_day: Every hall booking includes the kitchen and the cleaning. Hire is for the whole day.
hallhire.hire_is_whole_day_2: Every hall booking includes the kitchen and the cleaning. Hire is for the whole day.
hallhire.i_agree_to_the_terms_2: I have read and agree to the terms of hire, including use of the venue in accordance with Islamic rulings.
hallhire.no_one_hall_rate_weekend: There is no one-hall rate at the weekend.
hallhire.one_hall_mon_thu: One hall can only be hired Monday to Thursday. Pick another day, or take two halls.
hallhire.pay_within_thirty: Pay the £100 deposit within thirty minutes and the date is yours. If the deposit is not paid, the hold lapses and the date goes back on the calendar.
hallhire.phone_hint: The caretaker will call you before the day to arrange access, so this must be a number that reaches you.
hallhire.ring_the_office_or_team: Ring the office, or any of the booking team directly.
hallhire.t1_h: Use in accordance with Islamic rulings
hallhire.t1_p: Any hire agreement is subject to the venue being used in accordance with Islamic rulings. This includes, but is not limited to, no music being played on the premises. Agreeing to this is a condition of booking.
hallhire.t2_p1: A *£100 deposit* reserves your date. *The date is not held until the deposit is paid, and the deposit is paid online when you book.* Nothing else holds a date.
hallhire.t2_p2: The *full balance is due 30 days before* your booking date, and is paid at the office in cash or by bank transfer. It is not a fixed amount — it depends on how many halls you take, the day of the week, and whether the utensils or the utility charge apply — so the office confirms the figure when it calls you.
hallhire.t2_p3: The deposit is *not refundable if you cancel*. It *is refunded in full* if the masjid cannot give you the date — if we decline the booking, or if two payments reach us for the same day. You will not be left out of pocket for something that was not your doing.
hallhire.t3_h: Cleaning is included, and we do it
hallhire.t3_p: Cleaning is included in the hire charge and is carried out by Taiyabah Centre cleaners only. Please do not arrange your own cleaners. You are still responsible for taking away anything you brought in, and for leaving the venue in a reasonable state.
hallhire.t4_p: If you use the masjid’s utensils, a charge of *£100* applies. If you cook your own food in the kitchen, a utility charge of *45p per person* applies. Neither is charged unless it applies to your booking — the office confirms the final figure when it calls you.
hallhire.t5_p: A caretaker will be in touch before the day of your booking to arrange access to the venue. Please make sure the contact details you give us are ones you can be reached on.
hallhire.t6_h: How far ahead you can book
hallhire.t6_p: Bookings can be made up to 12 months in advance. Dates beyond that are not available to book and cannot be provisionally held.
hallhire.t7_p1: The *£100 deposit is not refundable if you cancel*, including if you cancel the same day you booked. Anything you have paid beyond the deposit is refunded if you cancel *more than 30 days before* your booked date. Inside 30 days the balance is not refundable — but we will move your booking to another date instead, once, subject to what is free. Ring the office as early as you can: the sooner we know, the more likely we can offer the date you want.
hallhire.t7_p2: If *the masjid* cancels or cannot honour your date, everything you have paid is refunded in full, deposit included.
hallhire.t8_p: The person named on the booking is responsible for the condition the venue is left in, including anything done by their guests. Where damage has been caused, a charge of *£100* applies. This is separate from the cleaning and waste-removal charges above.
hallhire.taiyabah_centre_a_separate_buil: Taiyabah Centre — a separate building owned by the masjid — offers three halls and two kitchens for hire, suitable for a range of community and family occasions.
hallhire.the_caretaker_will_call_you: The caretaker will call you before the day to arrange access, so it must be a number that reaches you.
hallhire.utility_charge_if_you_cook: Utility charge, if you cook in the kitchen
hol.below_90_by_the_end: Below 90% by the end of a term means losing the place
hol.every_day_the_madrasah_is: Every day the madrasah is closed this year, alongside the Islamic dates — so you can plan a trip without it costing your child their attendance.
hol.ring_the_office_on_the_day: Ring the office on the day, between 5pm and 7pm
hol.tell_us_about_lateness_too: Tell us about lateness too, not only absence

hol.the_islamic_calendar_follows_the: The Islamic calendar follows the moon, so the exact day is confirmed by sighting and can fall a day either side of what is shown here. These are calculated from the Umm al-Qurā calendar and are shown so you can plan — the masjid announces the confirmed date for Ramadhan and each Eid beforehand. The madrasah’s closure dates above are fixed and were set by the madrasah itself.
hol.the_madrasah_follows_boltons_term: The madrasah follows Bolton Council’s term dates and expects holidays to be taken outside them. If you must travel during term, collect a *Holiday Absence Form* from the office and return it three weeks before you go.
hol.the_madrasah_teaches_180_days: The madrasah teaches 180 days this year — 36 weeks, Monday to Friday, 5pm to 7pm. Hifz students also attend on Saturday mornings. Everything below applies to every class.
hol.the_two_long_breaks: The two long breaks — Ramadhan (33 days) and the summer (40 days) — are when a family trip costs nothing in attendance. Everything else is a week or less.
hol.unreported_absence_is_recorded_as: Unreported absence is recorded as unauthorised
hol.without_it_the_absence_is: Without it the absence is unauthorised, and it counts against the 90% your child needs to keep their place. A handwritten letter is not accepted.

marriage.a_nikah_performed_at_the: A Nikāḥ performed at the masjid is not, by itself, a marriage recognised under UK law. We strongly encourage every couple to additionally complete a separate civil marriage — this protects both partners’ legal rights, including around property and inheritance, should the need ever arise.
marriage.for_many_couples_an_islamic: For many couples, an Islamic ceremony carries a significance that a civil registration alone does not provide. Taiyabah Masjid is able to conduct this Nikāḥ on your behalf, in keeping with authentic Islamic practice — both parties giving their free and informed consent, and the groom presenting a dowry (mahr) to the bride as part of the contract.

will.a_muslim_who_has_something: “A Muslim who has something to leave behind should not let two nights pass without having his will written and kept ready.”
will.an_islamic_will_sets_out: An Islamic will sets out, in your own words, while you are able to:
will.any_funeral_wishes_you_would: Any funeral wishes you would like to be followed
will.because_these_calculations_depend_o: Because these calculations depend on your own family circumstances, they are best worked through individually with the imam or a solicitor experienced in Islamic wills — rather than estimated in general terms here.
will.how_your_property_and_other: How your property and other assets should be dealt with
will.islamic_inheritance_follows_fixed_s: Islamic inheritance follows fixed shares (Farā’iḍ) set out in the Qur’an for specific family members. A will does not override these shares, but it lets you address anything the fixed shares do not cover — for example, up to a third of your estate may be left to people or causes outside your Islamic heirs, such as a charitable gift.
will.some_choose_to_include_a: Some choose to include a charitable bequest in their will as a final, lasting act of Ṣadaqah. If you would like to consider including a gift to Taiyabah Masjid, let the solicitor helping you write your will know, or ask the office about adding a codicil if you already have a will in place.
will.speak_to_the_imam_call: Speak to the imam · call the main office
will.the_importance_of_an_islamic: The Importance of an Islamic Will
will.the_prophet_sahih_al_bukhari: The Prophet ﷺ · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim
will.this_page_is_a_starting: This page is a starting point, not legal, financial or religious advice for your own circumstances. UK inheritance tax and probate rules are detailed and change over time — please speak to a qualified solicitor to write your will, and to the imam for guidance on the Islamic shares that apply to your family.
will.when_a_muslim_passes_away: When a Muslim passes away without having made their wishes clear, their estate is left to be settled according to the default rules of the country they lived in — which may not reflect Islamic guidance on how a person’s wealth should be distributed.
will.when_death_approaches_one_of: “When death approaches one of you, and you leave behind good, it is prescribed that you make a bequest — a duty upon those mindful of Allah.”
will.who_is_entitled_to_benefit: Who is entitled to benefit from your estate, and in what shares
will.who_you_trust_to_carry: Who you trust to carry this out on your behalf — your executors

zakat.disclaimer: This is a guide, not a ruling. Zakat on a business, on a pension, or on property bought to let can be more involved — ask an imam if your situation is not a simple one.

zakat.nisab_is_the_minimum: Nisab is the minimum you must own before zakat is due. It is fixed in gold and silver, so it moves with the price.
zakat.nisab_is_the_minimum_you: Nisab is the minimum you must own before zakat is due. It is fixed in gold and silver, so its value in pounds changes with the metal price.
zakat.no_zakat_due: No zakat is due on this amount. Ṣadaqah is always welcome.
zakat.pick_the_same_date_each: Pick the same date each Islamic year — many choose a day in Ramadan — and work out your zakat on that day every year.
zakat.shares_bought_to_trade_and: Shares bought to trade, and cryptocurrency
zakat.the_hanafi_school_uses_the: The Hanafi school uses the *silver* nisab, which is lower — so more people qualify to give.
zakat.this_is_a_guide_not: *This is a guide, not a ruling.* It follows the Hanafi position and uses the price you enter. Zakat can depend on your own circumstances, and scholars differ on things like pensions, shares and long-term debt. For anything you are unsure about, please ask the imam at the masjid.

zakat.zakat_is_a_share_of: Zakat is a share of your savings given each year to those in need. It is *2.5%* — £2.50 out of every £100 you have kept for a whole year.
